Operating Characteristics for Quantitative Trial Decisions

Source: R/class_operating_charcteristics.R
OperatingCharcteristics.Rd

A lightweight container for operating-characteristics results produced by the QTD helpers. Instances store the originating design, tested sample-size scenarios and the resulting category probabilities used for plotting and reporting.

Initializes the shared quantitative operating-characteristics fields.

Arguments

design

The originating quantitative decision rule.

numberOfSubjects

Matrix of control and treatment sample sizes.

probabilities

Computed probability data frame.

Value

An R6 object of class OperatingCharcteristics.

Details

This internal base class supplies inherited fields for OperatingCharcteristicsMeans and OperatingCharcteristicsRates. Obtain result objects through getOperatingCharacteristicsMeans() or getOperatingCharacteristicsRates(). The originating design is stored internally.

Fields

numberOfSubjects

Supplied sample-size scenarios. Rows correspond to scenarios; the two columns contain the positive integer numbers of control and treatment subjects, in that order. Repeated scenarios are retained. Is a numeric matrix.

probabilities

Computed data frame of decision-category probabilities. Contains one block per sample-size scenario, with all six categories and all supplied effect or rate scenarios. Columns identify the category, probability, control and treatment sample sizes, true effect and endpoint-specific assumptions.

See also

getOperatingCharacteristicsMeans(), getOperatingCharacteristicsRates()

Examples

rule <- getDesignQuantitative(targetValue = 1, lowerReferenceValue = 0)
nMatrix <- matrix(c(50, 100), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)
# oc <- getOperatingCharacteristicsMeans(design = rule, numberOfSubjects = nMatrix)
